text_block_list.text:
While walking along the riverbed, Gold 
Ship called out to stop me. Feeling a 
slight sense of unease, I listened—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I picked up a grimoire on that island the 
other day. I'm about to chant a spell, so 
watch and learn.
choice_data_list:
A grimoire? But why are you using a 
smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I sliced it up and made an e-book out of 
it. Tentacles kept sprouting every time I 
turned a page, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Digital is just the way of the future, 
man. Oh, this one looks pretty sick. A 
spell to shatter the walls of space-time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
E-we-WE! I-ya! I-wa-YA! 
Yo-WO-gu-yu・So-to-fo-to-wi!

Before I could stop her, Gold Ship recited 
some sort of indescribable incantation.
(*SPLAAASH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ooh, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
*Cough*, *gasp*, *glub*! The hell is your 
problem, river surface?! Skip me higher, 
dammit!!
choice_data_list: A horse girl just dived into the river?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wait, could that be... me?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To be precise, it might be me as a kid. 
Back when I was just a little bit feral...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Looking for something fun to do, I'd crush 
evil secret societies, or crush good 
secret societies, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Everything was just so boring. Whenever 
I was bored out of my skull, that was the 
game I played.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—"Golshi Stone Skipping." A game where you 
fling yourself across the water like a 
rock and try to reach the other side.
choice_data_list:
You might be the only person who's ever 
played that...

You might be the only person who's ever 
played that...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
The hell are you lookin' at, horse girl?! 
Is watchin' me really that entertaining, 
HUH?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Is doing it entertaining for youuu?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Like hell it is!! I don't skip across the 
water like a rock, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In that case, try running in a race! 
You'll go way more airborne than hoppin' 
across a river!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
A race?! What a joke! I'll march right out 
there and get bored in one nanosecond 
flat!

The horse girl dashed off at full sprint. 
Was she just an eccentric horse girl, or 
could she really have been Gold Ship as a 
child...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this grimoire is pretty neat. 
...Could other timelines work too, maybe?

When Gold Ship chanted the spell again, a 
horse girl out for a run appeared on the 
opposite bank. For some reason, the other 
side looked bathed in twilight—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? Oooh! Long time no see! Come to think 
of it, it was around dusk just like this 
when we first met, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! You over there! Are you! Having fun 
right nowww?!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's all you wanna ask? Don't you wanna 
know how many GⅠ wins we got, or if we 
repelled the Plutonian invasion?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!! Just tell me if you're having 
fun right now!!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, so sad! That's the one thing I 
can't tell you!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I'm busy! I've gotta run 
history's first lunar surface race in the 
Dream Trophy League!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh... Sounds like a blast.

Before I realized it, the horse girl on 
the other side had vanished. Was she just 
an upperclassman teasing Gold Ship, or was 
she the real—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, for the grand finale, let's meet 
Golshi-chan from 5 billion years in the 
future!

When Gold Ship chanted the spell, someone 
on the opposite bank—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san! What are you doing over 
there?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan?! Does that mean 5 billion years 
from now, I evolve into *her*?!
choice_data_list: I think that's just the real Kitasan...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't screw with me, damn it! I'm 
Golshi-chan for all eternity, ya hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did you just jump in the river—whoa, 
she crossed it! And she's super mad!! What 
is going on?!
choice_data_list: What was it we saw on the other side?

text_block_list.text:
Having crossed the river, the sight of 
Gold Ship pouncing on Kitasan Black 
dissolved into the shimmering light on the 
water.

Even as evening fell, Gold Ship from 5 
billion years in the future never showed 
up.
—No one appeared.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
............ A whole lifetime... is one 
last run, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—This is no time to be gettin' all 
sentimental! I've got a whole light-year's 
worth of races I wanna enter!

Gold Ship's sprinting silhouette melted 
away beyond the sunset sinking toward 
tomorrow.
